clue.text: God lives on middle of supposedly blue river

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece written on another follows it, so the verb comes after the trimmed river
only the middle of the river's name is wanted, so its first and last letters are trimmed away

parts.note: the Danube, famous from Strauss's waltz The Blue Danube, though its waters are rarely blue
lives means exists, is

explanation.surface: A deity resides beside the middle stretch of a river that is only reputedly blue.
explanation.walkthrough: The Blue Danube waltz gives the river its supposed colour; 'middle of' drops its outer letters, and 'on' means following in an across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian deity of the dead and embalming.

clue.text: One country understood another deposing king

indicators.note: deposing a monarch removes him, so the king's letter is taken out

parts.note: understood means knew
K is the chess abbreviation for king
another country, Guinea in West Africa

explanation.surface: One nation grasped that a second had overthrown its monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deposing' takes K from KNEW, leaving NEW; GUINEA is the other country.
explanation.definitionFit: New Guinea is a large island shared by two states, loosely a land or country.

clue.text: Put money on house in Kent, and face ruin

parts.note: to put money on something is to bet
an oast house is a kiln for drying hops, typical of the English county of Kent

explanation.surface: Gambling on a Kentish property and heading for financial disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Being toast is slang for being doomed or finished.

clue.text: Very hard element of scale

parts.note: so means very, as in so good
H stands for hard, as on pencils

explanation.walkthrough: 'element of scale' suggests chemistry or limescale; it is a note of the sol-fa musical scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Soh is the fifth note of the tonic sol-fa scale.

clue.text: In squash matches losing a second

parts.note: matches as a verb means compares, sets side by side

explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops the article from the verb for matches; 'In' is only a link, and squash is a verb, not the racket game.
explanation.definitionFit: To squash something is to press it tight, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Churchman writes article in study

indicators.note: in places the article inside the word for study

parts.note: con is an old word meaning study or learn
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A clergyman writes a piece in his study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writes' is a link word here.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a member of the clergy attached to a cathedral chapter.

clue.text: People, even if behind with dinner at first, given mint

parts.note: men means people
tho is a short form of though, even if
late means behind time

indicators.note: at first takes only the first letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: People, though late for dinner, are handed a mint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Mentholated means treated or flavoured with menthol, the essence of mint.

clue.text: Almost lie, with mere answer

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the last letter is cut

parts.note: to rest is to lie down
a mere is a small lake or pond

explanation.surface: Nearly a lie, with just an answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' trims REST to RES; 'mere' is not 'only' but a lake. 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To respond is to reply, give an answer, a straight synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Embracing wife, shortly experience ecstasy

parts.note: soon means shortly

explanation.surface: Hugging his wife, he is soon transported with joy.

explanation.definitionFit: To swoon is to be overcome with rapture, to faint with delight.

clue.text: Lad consumed with desire to get to work

an itch is a restless desire

explanation.definitionFit: Switching on a machine sets it running, makes it start operating.

clue.text: Not appearing to eat? Painful!

parts.note: nosh is informal for eat
ow is the cry of someone in pain

explanation.surface: Someone stays away from a meal because eating hurts.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-show is someone who fails to turn up, so the phrase works adjectivally for absent.

clue.text: Normal hunt abandoned in revolutionary period

clue.text: Host welcomes Daisy, a girl for advanced tuition

clue.text: Grunt, seeing why printer won't work?

clue.text: Sort of garden bird

a wading bird of the sandpiper family

explanation.definitionFit: Both a formal herb garden style and a small wading shorebird share this name.

clue.text: What's bolted as ordered by men, too late?

definitions.text: What's bolted as ordered by men, too late?

indicators.note: by means beside, so the soldiers' letters stand next to the rearranged words
ordered means arranged, so the two words are put in a new order

parts.note: OR, other ranks, is the usual abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Locking up only after soldiers have given the order, when it is already too late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges the two words, and men gives other ranks. The idiom is shutting the stable door after the horse has bolted.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbially the stable door gets locked only once the horse has escaped, a precaution taken too late.

clue.text: Not quite an approval? Entirely one

parts.note: yes is a word of approval

explanation.surface: Something falling short of an approval, though wholly one.

explanation.definitionFit: Aye is a vote in favour, so the word is wholly an expression of agreement.

clue.text: Dull colour a lovebird sported

clue.text: Birth of dwarf?

clue.text: One thirsting to drink litre — of his punch?

clue.text: Enter, dropping me a little money
